(3) The girl looks directly at the camera, talking and gesturing with her hands while still chewing. The man smiles and watches her. (4) Close-up shot of the girl's face as she reacts with a wide-eyed expression of delight, a yellow caption appears. (5) The girl attempts to feed a piece of the burger to the man, then quickly pulls it back to her own mouth, smiling playfully. (6) The girl takes another massive bite, squeezing her eyes shut in enjoyment. (7) The camera cuts to a close-up of a white box filled with french fries on the table. (8) The girl picks up a single fry, looking excited. (9) The girl waves her hands and does a small seated dance, celebrating her snack. (10) The girl takes a final bite of the burger as the man encourages her. (11) A scene shift shows the girl running across a wooden floor towards a bathroom, looking back over her shoulder and smiling while wearing the same black t-shirt. (12) A pink screen appears with a cartoon character logo and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
